calibration.reason: The original PDS GSDR dataset description and USGS catalogue both define DN = slope_degrees × 10 + 1. The detached ISIS label instead gives Multiplier 0.005 and Base -0.1, which contradict that equation and produces negative roughness for some valid positive DNs. Use the primary PDS equation and retain the conflicting label.
